landing.heroTitle: Ɣ tadggʷat n yan inna izwarn d yan urba ifulkin
landing.heroLede: Tasga n uslmd ijmɛn ihilan d ilmuden ɣ tussna d tdlsa d tmetti, ar tsnnurqi tanflit yaḍfarn d uɣlluy n tmetti, ar ttṛẓam tiwwura nns i imqqurn d imẓẓiyn d irbaan.

landing.missionTitle: Aslmd illan i kullu, d uḍfar ur ittbbin
landing.missionLede: Nɣwi is kraygatt yat dars amur nns ɣ tussna, kigan ad ig wussan nns niɣ addad nns. Ɣmkan a nttṛẓam tiḥlaqin nnɣ i imqqurn dat imẓẓiyn, ar nttḍfar asnfl n kraygatt tamstafidt s uḍfar ufrdi ittyaran, machi ɣas tilin ɣ usjjl.
landing.stagesLede: Tggawa tamsukayt ɣ kraḍt tsuraf; kraygatt tasurft dars iswirn nns d tḥlaqin nns d lwqqat nns n imalass.
landing.stageAdultBody: Tiḥlaqin n uḥfaḍ d tmrajɛa n Lqurʔan lkrim, d ilmuden ɣ tussniwin n ddin, d tfṛkiwin n umḥḥu n tisnt i ttin ur iwiɣn ad tlmd ɣ temẓi nns.
landing.stageAdultMeta: Ar ismun aswir n umḥḥu n tisnt d iswirn n uḥfaḍ
landing.stageTeenBody: Ahil ar issmuttul ger uḥfaḍ n Lqurʔan lkrim d ufham n lmɛani nns, d ilmuden ttsnmyafn d tsurft n tmẓḍḍurt d twuri n tinml.
landing.stageChildBody: Asbdd zik ɣ tɣuri d uḥfaḍ s yan uɣaras ittuyrin, ddaw uḍfar n tsslmadin, d uḍfar n imawlan s imiḍanen nnsn.
landing.stageChildMeta: Ar iḍffar bab n urba asnfl n urba nns
landing.howTitle: Kraḍt tsurifin ar asnti n tḥlaqt
landing.howLede: Askr ur ixṣṣa tirzi zik; tamtturt kullu tzḍar ad tkmml ɣ tilifun.
landing.step1Body: Akcam ar ittili s umiḍan Google ɣas, bla awal uffir ma ttyaḥḍan niɣ ma ttyattun.
landing.step2Body: Ar ttɛmmar yat tfrkit i tnelmadt, niɣ i bab n urba d urba nns s sin, d imsrayn lli ixṣṣan s ubayn.
landing.step3Title: Asmuḍ n tmtturt d urẓam nns
landing.step3Body: Ar tsmuḍ tanmhalt n tmsmunt tamtturt, ɣ tggira n umsrad ar ittuṛẓm umiḍan ar ittusnmal i tsga d tḥlaqt lli s ifulkin.

install.title: Asbdd n Bodour Al Amal ɣ wallal
install.note: Asnas iga tiɣrrit nit: ar ittuṛẓam zɣ yat tawlaft ɣ ugdil bla tasga n umsnud, ar iḥtaj Internet zund asmel.
install.ios.lede: Ɣ iPhone d iPad, asbdd ar ittili zɣ umsnud Safari:
install.ios.step1: Adbbaḥ ɣ tqfalt «Bḍu» ɣ tsga n Safari (yan umkuẓ iffɣ dars yan unccab s afella).
install.ios.step2: Azuɣr n umuɣ s wadda d usti n «Rnu s ugdil amzwaru».
install.ios.step3: Adbbaḥ ɣ «Rnu». Ad tbayyn tawlaft n Bodour Al Amal ɣ ugdil.
install.manual.lede: Asbdd ar ittili zɣ umuɣ n umsnud:
install.manual.step1: Arẓam n umuɣ n umsnud (kraḍt tinqqiḍin ⋮ ɣ afella n ugdil niɣ ɣ wadda nns).
install.manual.step2: Asti n «Sbdd asnas» niɣ «Rnu s ugdil amzwaru».
install.manual.step3: Asentem n usbdd. Ad tbayyn tawlaft n Bodour Al Amal ɣ ugdil.
content.edit.title: Asnfl n uferdis n ugbur
content.edit.fileUnchanged: Ar ittusnfl ɣas aglam n uferdis; afaylu nit ur ittuɛawad asali nns.
content.edit.wholeCategoryHint: Aferdis ar ittili i iswirn akkʷ n tggayt n uswir lli ittustayn — wid illan d wid ad ittuzaydn ukan — ar ibayyn ɣ tsga «Iswirn akkʷ n tggayt» ɣ ugbur n uslmd. Ur ibddl uswir n ubayn wala afaylu.
content.edit.additionalLevelsHint: Aswir n afella iga aswir n ufaylu amenzu. Da ar ttuzaydn iswirn yaḍnin ixṣṣa — asklas n yat tɣimit lli ismunn sin iswirn, ɣ umdya — ar t ẓṛṛant tmstafidin nnsn ula nttnti iɣ iga uslig. Ilaq ad ittyaslmad tsnalt ɣ kraygatt aswir ittustayn.
content.edit.consentWarning: Ḥḍu: gr tmstafidin n usklas ad, tlla ylli ur imsrad bab nns ɣ usufɣ n umsli/tugna. Aswir n ubayn ar iqqim zund ma ittustayn da, walaynni ifulki ad ig «uslig».
content.edit.objectMissing: Ur ittyufa ufaylu iḥḍan n uferdis ad, ihat ur ibddl uswir n ubayn. Isfka yaḍnin ur ttumassn.
content.edit.storageMoveFailed: Ur izḍar ufaylu ad immutti s udɣar nns amaynu, ihat ur ittuḥḍa ubddl n uswir n ubayn. Afaylu amenzu iṣḥa.
content.edit.concurrent: Aferdis ad ittusnfl zɣ yan udɣar yaḍn ɣ lwqt n uḥḍu. Ilaq ad ittuɛawd usali n tasna ukan ad ittuɛawd urmmu.
